craft.description: Full build flow for React Native features: shape, build with Expo, verify on device. Use when building a new screen or feature end-to-end.

init.description: Sets up a project for impeccable-rn. Runs discovery interview and writes PRODUCT.md. Use once per project.

document.description: Generate DESIGN.md that captures the current RN visual design system. Auto-extracts colors, typography, spacing, and component patterns from the codebase.

extract.description: Pull reusable patterns, components, and design tokens into the RN design system. Consolidates repeated patterns across the codebase.

animate.description: Review a feature and enhance with purposeful Reanimated animations, micro-interactions, and motion that improve usability.

bolder.description: Amplify safe or boring RN designs to make them more visually interesting while maintaining usability.

clarify.description: Improve unclear UX copy, error messages, labels, and instructions in the RN app.

colorize.description: Add strategic color to monochromatic RN UIs, turning flat palettes into intentional systems.

critique.description: UX design review with heuristic scoring (Nielsen), cognitive load assessment, persona testing, and RN-specific component audit.

delight.description: Add moments of joy, personality, and unexpected touches that make the RN app memorable.

distill.description: Strip RN designs to their essence by removing unnecessary complexity.

harden.description: Make RN interfaces production-ready: offline, errors, i18n, text overflow, edge cases.

onboard.description: Design onboarding, first-run experiences, and empty states for the RN app.

layout.description: Fix RN Flexbox layout, spacing, safe areas, and visual rhythm.

optimize.description: Diagnose and fix RN performance: FlashList, expo-image, MMKV, Reanimated, memoization.

overdrive.description: Push past conventional limits with Skia, Lottie, and advanced Reanimated in RN.

polish.description: Final quality pass for RN: check all states, tokens, interactions, accessibility.

quieter.description: Tone down visually aggressive or overstimulating RN designs.

shape.description: Plan RN UX/UI before code. Produces a confirmed design brief for implementation.

typeset.description: Improve RN typography: expo-font loading, hierarchy, sizing, platform fonts.
